description: Foxconn T77W968 / Dell DW5821e family (Snapdragon X20, LTE Cat.16): family base, never matched itself; one firmware and AT set under Dell, Foxconn and Telit LN960 identities; ModemManager gets the control and net ports only, the ttys stay with the engine

recovery.source: another modem manager 3.2.2: MM-only in QMI and MBIM (umbim/uqmi: address without traffic); AT beside MM drops the session (issue #13); field: AT^RESET left no netdev (tg 2026-07-20)

radio.source: another modem manager 3.4.0 _foxconn_t77w968 / _foxconn_common1: AT^SLMODE codes 4 auto, 14 WCDMA, 30 LTE, 35 WCDMA+LTE (not the T99W175 mask); AT^SLBAND? / =? / =LTE,2,<list>; firmware forms from 4pda fixtures

ussd_at_on_lte.source: the owner's T77W968 on MegaFon, 2026-11-02: ModemManager's USSD on LTE ended after 41 s each time, the same code over the engine's AT port was answered

ussd_cs_fallback.source: bench 2026-10-26 (DW5821e/T77W968, MBIM under ModemManager, MegaFon): USSD *100# on LTE detached packet service 1 s after the request, ModemManager answered 'USSD terminated by network' after 39 s, the bearer dropped and netifd reconnected 1.5 min later
